{{Quote|With a meal or as a treat by itself, this old time favorite is sure to please!|Dex's Diner menu, on the blue milkshake|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Blue milkshake''' was a thick and creamy beverage made from<ref name="Menu" /> frozen<ref name="Ascension" /> [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] and included [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] and flavored syrups.<ref name="Menu" /> A high-calorie concoction, it had a [[Temperature/Legends|cooling]] effect,<ref name="Ascension" /> and was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on<ref name="Menu" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where it was mixed by robo-appendages and cost 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per unit.<ref name="Menu" />

In [[44 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] enjoyed sipping the milkshake while dining in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varlo]]'s [[Riverview Café]]<ref name="Ascension" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> world [[Roonadan]]. To her embarrassment, she slurped the cool concoction through her straw, and she made sure to say "excuse me" as she was in the presence of her [[Parent/Legends|grandparents]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Leia was dismayed that Allana was already finishing her drink, chiding that the milkshake had "enough calories to feed a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for two [[Standard day/Legends|days]]" and further commenting that the family should strand the [[Youngling/Legends|young girl]] somewhere with only a supply of blue milkshake for sustenance, which prompted Allana to giggle.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blue milkshake was first mentioned in [[Dining at Dex's]], a feature exclusive to the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] club members on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Menu" /> It appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', though spelled as "blue milk shake."<ref name="Ascension" />
